root_causes.description: High volume of AR exceptions totaling $2.6M indicates potential data integrity issues in accounts receivable processing.
Bank duplicates (13 instances) suggest inadequate controls in reconciliation workflows.
root_causes.financial_impact: Potential misstatements in cash balances due to duplicate records.

root_causes.description: AP exceptions totaling $653,977.70 highlight potential errors in accounts payable accruals or postings.

remediations.action: Perform a detailed review of AR exception reports to identify and correct data integrity issues. Implement automated validation checks for AR postings.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in AR exceptions to <5 items and <$50K total impact in the next reporting period.

remediations.action: Enhance reconciliation workflows by implementing duplicate detection algorithms and periodic audits of bank records.
remediations.success_criteria: Elimination of duplicate bank records in subsequent reconciliations.

remediations.action: Investigate AP exceptions to identify root causes (e.g., incorrect accruals or postings). Train staff on updated AP processes and controls.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in AP exceptions to <$50K total impact in the next reporting cycle.
